title: operad access user layer
description: The always-allowed calls in $OPERAD_HOME/access-user.json: each binds an exact command and working directory, or a tool, path and working directory. A person adds them by answering allow_always, and can remove one by deleting its line.

value.description: The command text, exactly as the person allowed it; for an MCP tool, `mcp <server>.<tool>`.

cwd.description: The working directory the command was allowed in.

value.description: The path, as the call wrote it.

cwd.description: The working directory the path was allowed in.

tool.description: The tool the person allowed on that path, such as write or edit.
